introduction.purpose: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for a project management application that enables small teams to manage tasks, set reminders, control access based on roles, and export project data to PDF format.

product_scope.summary: A web-based project management solution for small teams (under 100 users) featuring task management, reminder system, role-based access control, and PDF export functionality.
business_objectives: Provide an intuitive project management platform for small business teams
Enable efficient task tracking and reminder management
Support project documentation through PDF export capabilities
benefits: Improved team collaboration and project visibility
Reduced missed deadlines through automated reminders
Enhanced security through role-based access control
goals: Deliver a fully functional web-based project management application
Support up to 100 concurrent users at launch

product_perspective.system_context: The project management application is a standalone web-based system that operates through standard web browsers. It includes user authentication, project management features, reminder system, access control, and export capabilities without requiring integration with external systems.

performance_requirements.description: The system shall support up to 100 concurrent users without performance degradation
Page loads shall complete within 3 seconds under normal load conditions
PDF generation shall complete within 30 seconds for typical project reports
Database queries shall return results within 1 second for standard operations

safety_requirements.description: The system shall prevent accidental loss of active project work.
safety_requirements.hazard: Loss of project inputs or artifacts

security_requirements.description: All user authentication shall use secure password hashing and salting
Role-based access control shall be enforced for all system functions
All data transmission shall use HTTPS encryption
User sessions shall be properly managed and secured against hijacking
Password reset functionality shall include security measures to prevent abuse

software_quality_attributes.description: Non-technical users should complete the intake and answer flow without training.

business_rules.description: Only administrators can create new projects and manage user roles
Team members can only view and update tasks assigned to them
PDF exports are only available to users with appropriate project access
Reminders are sent based on configurable time intervals before deadlines
User roles determine access to specific project management features

database_requirements.description: The database shall store user accounts with secure password hashes
Project and task data shall be stored with proper relationships and indexing
User role assignments and permissions shall be stored and easily queryable
Reminder schedules and notification history shall be maintained
PDF export history and generated files metadata shall be stored

analyst_workspace.analysis_summary: This Software Requirements Specification defines the requirements for a web-based project management application designed for small teams. The system will provide task management with reminders, role-based access control, and PDF export capabilities. Primary users are business owners and administrators who need to manage team projects efficiently. The application will be accessible via web browser with email/password authentication and is designed to support up to 100 concurrent users.
